const errorStatusCodes: Record<string, number> = {{{errorStatusCodes}}}

const app = express()
app.use(helmet())

{{{routesCode}}}

// Error handlers must be registered after all routes so they can receive errors
// after (forwarded by) route-specific middleware such as CORS, rate limiting and body parsers.
app.use(async (error: unknown, req: Request, res: Response, _next: NextFunction) => {
    const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    const errorName = error instanceof Error ? error.name : typeof error
    const errorStack = error instanceof Error ? error.stack : undefined
    const configuredStatus = error instanceof Error ? errorStatusCodes[error.constructor.name] : undefined
    const middlewareStatus = typeof error === 'object' && error !== null && 'status' in error
        ? error.status
        : undefined
    const httpStatus = typeof configuredStatus === 'number'
        ? configuredStatus
        : typeof middlewareStatus === 'number' && middlewareStatus >= 400 && middlewareStatus <= 599
            ? middlewareStatus
            : 500

    await writeLog('ERROR', 'Unhandled request error', {
        method: req.method,
        path: req.path,
        errorName,
        errorMessage,
        errorStack
    })
    
    res.status(httpStatus).json({ error: 'Request failed' })
})

const port = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3000)

app.listen(port, async () => {
    await writeLog('INFO', `Generated server listening on port ${port}`)
}).on('error', async (error) => {
    await writeLog('ERROR', `Failed to start server on port ${port}`, { error: error.message })
    process.exit(1)
})

export default app
